source.model: within each project: log(speed_ms) ~ release-year fixed effects + within-project-year body length + within-project-year release timing + ordinal Durif stage

interpretation: No evidence that the post-activation Durif-speed coefficient differs strongly among the six analysed projects. The pooled near-null is therefore not obviously produced by cancellation of large opposite project-specific effects.
boundary: This is a post-hoc heterogeneity audit motivated by new external evidence, not preregistered confirmation.
A non-significant heterogeneity test does not prove identical stage effects across all European eel systems.
The 2026 River Test progression endpoint and covariate structure are not identical to the Europe-wide overall-speed endpoint.
Do not infer that external route context causally replaces internal state from this result.
